settings.title: Settings

rsvpModes.BOTH: Personal links and form on the page

settings.rsvpModeHint: Form on the page: guests type their name and the app finds them on the guest list.
settings.cashGiftHint: E.g. “Instead of flowers, please support our honeymoon”
settings.mealDeleteHint: Deleting clears it for guests who chose it. You can deactivate it instead.
settings.childTiersHint: Percent of the adult plate price, e.g. 0–3 years: 0%, 4–12 years: 50%.
